## Changes since v0.8.0

### External MCP, Skill, and host plugins

- Pi: `pi install npm:pi-mcp-adapter` then `pi install npm:scientific-figure-library`. The package loads the core Skill and registers the stdio MCP server through pi-mcp-adapter.
- DeepSeek Harness: `dsh plugin --profile web add scientific-figure-library`. The bundle registers the Skill and mounts `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` against this package.
- GitHub Release now publishes the verified tarball to npm when `NPM_TOKEN` is set, so those install commands resolve on the registry.
- npm / Pi / dsh catalog keywords (`pi-package`, `dsh-plugin`, `deepseek-harness`) and bilingual dsh plugin summary for discovery.
- README splits Pi and dsh install from the clone-and-register prompt, and warns against installing both a local-app MCP config and the npm package.

### Packaging

- The npm tarball no longer ships FigureYa and Open Figure Modules gallery image bytes. It keeps catalog plus pinned per-image identities; PreviewDownloadStore fetches previews on demand into the user cache, matching local-client behavior.

## 相对 v0.8.0 的变化

### 外部 MCP、Skill 与宿主插件

- Pi：先 `pi install npm:pi-mcp-adapter`，再 `pi install npm:scientific-figure-library`。包会加载核心 Skill，并通过 pi-mcp-adapter 注册 stdio MCP。
- DeepSeek Harness：`dsh plugin --profile web add scientific-figure-library`。bundle 注册 Skill，并用官方 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` 拉起本包。
- GitHub Release 在配置了 `NPM_TOKEN` 时把已校验 tarball 发到 npm，上述按包名安装的命令才能解析。
- 增加 npm / Pi / dsh 目录检索词（`pi-package`、`dsh-plugin`、`deepseek-harness`）和中英 dsh 插件摘要。
- README 把 Pi、dsh 安装从「克隆仓库再挂 MCP」里拆开，并提醒不要和本机 App 的 MCP 配置叠装。

### 打包

- npm 包不再附带 FigureYa 与 Open Figure Modules 图库图片字节，只保留目录和逐图身份；预览按需下载到用户缓存，与本地客户端一致。
